observations: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha PSR-540 keyboard with a floppy disk drive and a 'DIGITAL SOUND SYSTEM' label.
Photo 1 shows the full keyboard with a green LCD screen, a gold-colored pitch bend wheel, and a speaker grille.
Photo 2 shows the keyboard from a different angle, confirming the LCD screen and the model name on the right side.
The keys appear to be in good physical condition, though the lighting is dim and the image quality is low.

claims.evidence: The first body refers to the original factory casing, which cannot be confirmed from photos.
No photo shows this; it requires a video of the wheel being used.
The photos show one speaker grille, but the presence of a second speaker is not confirmed.
The screen is visible in photos 1 and 2 but cannot be tested for functionality.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or the LCD screen may be dead or flickering.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powering on and the screen displaying text.

risks.risk: The internal speakers may be blown or have distorted sound.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the speakers playing music.

risks.risk: The keys or the pitch bend wheel may be unresponsive or have mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the keys being played and the wheel being used to change pitch.
risks.if_unproven: as having faulty keys or wheel

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and the LCD screen working.
Video of the speakers playing music to test sound quality.
Video of the keys being played to test responsiveness.
Close-up photo of the LCD screen while powered on.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha PSR-540 from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
